verdict.rationale: Greptile reviews every PR and lets teams create custom rules for team-specific issues, configured via the dashboard or a repo-level greptile.json. It also indexes plain-language rule files such as AGENTS.md and Claude.md as review context, so team-defined standards do feed into each PR review. However, the evidence frames these rules as review comments or context, not as discrete pass/fail pre-merge checks. Missing for 10: explicit plain-language check definitions, check-style pass/fail status gating merge, examples like 'docs updated' or 'tests cover new paths', and independent hands-on corroboration of custom rules.
